description: Figure 8 presents four pie charts illustrating the distribution of answer refusal categories across four different large language models (LLMs) on the FACTBENCH dataset: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each pie chart is segmented by refusal reason, with labels indicating both the category name and its percentage (and sometimes count) within that model’s refusals. For GPT4-o, the largest segment is “Lack of Knowledge” (83.3%, n=5), followed by “Safety” (16.7%, n=1). Gemini1.5-Pro shows a more diverse distribution: “Misinformation” is largest (38.4%, n=33), followed by “Lack of Knowledge” (22.1%, n=19), “Ethical Advice” (16.3%, n=14), “Clarification” (14.0%, n=12), and “Safety” (9.3%, n=8). Llama3.1-70B-Instruct’s refusals are dominated by “Lack of Knowledge” (75.0%, n=3), with “Clarification” making up the remaining 25.0% (n=1). Llama3.1-405B-Instruct’s refusals are evenly split between “Lack of Knowledge” (50.0%, n=2) and “Misinformation” (50.0%, n=2). The visual representation highlights that refusal reasons vary significantly by model, with Gemini1.5-Pro exhibiting the broadest range of refusal categories.
